snippet.title: Fantastic Annihilation - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Fantastic Annihilation is an intense action clicker where every click counts in your quest to destroy all life on earth. It offers a mix of strategy and dark comedy.

https://fantastichumans.itch.io/fantastic-annihilation

Disciple,
As the most devout follower of the Cult of the Last Messiah, you've been elevated to the role of the Great Annihilator. Your sacred mission: to annihilate every last trace of life on Earth and return the planet to its original, pure, desolate state—a barren world of rocky landscapes, devoid of sin and life.
But be warned: failure in your mission means your own annihilation.


Dynamic Action-Clicker Gameplay: Combine rapid clicking with strategic decision-making. Every click count toward your ultimate goal.

Resource Management: Balance your destructive impulses with resource management. Build structures and hire contractors to prevent the population from growing out of control.

Engaging Dark Narrative: Navigate the moral complexities of your mission with a touch of dark humor.


Sponsored by Gold Extra: Briefs 2024: This game was developed under the sponsorship of Gold Extra: Briefs 2024, inspired by the profound theme of "Death."

Content Warning: This game contains references to death in all shapes and forms. It may be distressing for some players. Please proceed with caution.

Game is part of the bundle Briefs 2024: https://itch.io/b/2656/briefs-2024-the-death-collection
